verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS networking platform, but nothing in the pack shows Tailscale offering a self-hostable coordination or control plane. The docs only cover running Tailscale nodes on-prem, in Docker or as Kubernetes sidecars, which is client deployment, not hosting the core service. The community note that clients (except iOS) can point at a custom control server is an adjacent client option that depends on a separately sourced server, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
